The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Horoth Gendi]] formed his own '''gang''' upon being given control of the [[Nikto Sector]], a region of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], by his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Horoth Gendi's master|master]]. Gendi used his gang to free himself from servitude, and the gang was the first in a line of Nikto gangs that controlled the district for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] afterward.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gendi's gang was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Nikto Sector in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
